_about: Every added sound on the film's clock, placed from data (sound.md §2). `at`/`from`/`to` are either seconds on the edit's clock, or 'Qxx_tN@s': seconds on that take's own clock, mapped through the edit decision list, so a re-cut moves them with their picture. `level` is the sound's loudness in the mix (LUFS over its length); the dialogue sits near -18, so beds are 22-29 dB under it and the few effects 11-14 dB under (the author wants few, quiet effects). The takes' own sync sound stays; these glue it and point up what the picture shows.

beds.why: one continuous street under every take, so the joins between generations stop changing the world
beds.af_why: earshot read the street take as partly wind (77% in forced choice against traffic); the high-pass takes out the rumble that carries it and keeps the bed out of the voices

boost.why: Q10 keeps only its voices; the street carries its ground

beds.why: from the first sight of the laundrette window, the machines turning behind them for the rest of the film

cues.why: the first picture: the yellow sweepers scrubbing the gutter
the city units lift the bag out of the street bin
Q05's insert: the sweeper's brush runs into Helena's boot and stops ("Apologies.")
the brush against Oren's taped slipper

music_duck.why: the score steps 7 dB further down under every spoken line (the spans the subtitles measured on the voice), so the words stay clear and the music speaks in the silences

music.why: Unseen: the low string drone on A minor from the fade-in; the guitar's first falling notes land on the sketch of her boots (A10, 0:20.5); gone before 'Excuse me.' (HELENA.md §5)
Her hand: the strings swell as she lowers herself onto his shoulder; the guitar's notes fall on her hand on him (2:32.6) and her open palm (2:35.2); out before she jokes it away

Recognised: silence while she chooses ('Not the recordings.'); the strings enter as she presses Send (3:43.3) and warm under the temple light; the guitar's phrase answers her rank as her head comes up (3:51.3); the swell fills her wordless reaction; it eases out under 'Helena will do.'
Didn't attend: a low string pedal under the lift and the two tours; a hard cut to silence after 'Didn't attend.', so 'Can you sit? Here. With me.' lands in quiet
The laugh: heard dry first; once it has broken, a light plucked guitar in C joins it, the film's first warmth (runs on into Q14 when it exists)

music_level_note: levels raised 1-2 dB after the author's note that the film barely had music: the score speaks in the silences, and ducks 8 dB under every line (each line stays 16 dB or more above it)
